items.description: Replacement pipe section, sealing and insulation
items.rationale: The internal supply-pipe failure is consistent with covered fracture damage under §2.4.3(a), though the precise failure mode is not stated. Section 7.1.7(c) allows like-for-like materials; comparable gross allowances are €42 for pipe, €24 for sealing and €22 for insulation.

Sections 7.1.7(a) and (g) cover necessary access and repair labour at customary rates. The single flat rate is not one hour; using the comparable bathroom repair as a guide, 10 hours at €76 gross gives €760.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice regardless of the number of visits. This is the only travel line on the repair invoice, so the €81 gross benchmark applies once.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and allow one equipment flat rate per operation. The comparable bathroom drying charge supports €439 gross for this single operation.

items.description: Close the wall opening and repaint the patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the necessary opening and repainting the disturbed patch, not the rest of the bathroom. The comparable combined closure and painting line supports €453 gross.
